messages:
Maya: Drafting a 3-email trial nurture focused on activation and routing hot prospects to SDRs.

Ethan: +1. metric target? :bar_chart:

Maya: Aim: 40% first-api-call within 7 days for users who open >=1 email. Baseline ~22%.

Priya: Segment plan?

Maya: 3 segments: cold (0 calls in 48h) -> quickstart; warm (1-5 calls) -> batching/embeds tips; hot (>5 calls) -> upgrade + contact.

Jordan: subject ideas (short/mobile-first):
- Cold A: "Jumpstart: your first Redwood call in 5 mins"
- Cold B: "Quickstart inside: get your first response"
- Warm A: "Reduce tokens with smart batching"
- Warm B: "More throughput, less cost"
- Hot A: "Scale confidently: Dedicated options"

Camille: A/B cold & warm. single focused CTA for hot (book demo / pricing). also propose a 1-click micro-survey in email3.

Maya: Cadence: send0=immediate on signup, send2=48h, send3=day6. If a user activates before send2 -> skip send2 and send a "thanks" variant at day6.

Ethan: Routing idea: if calls >50 in 48h OR token usage >100k -> tag "trial-hot" and post daily digest to #sales-trial-hot. eng-bench-bot attaches a usage snapshot.

Priya: Copy drafts (short):
- Cold email 1: "Start your first call - 3 lines to get you going" + tiny code example
- Warm email 2: "Batching & caching tips" + link to short blog + benchmark GIF
- Hot email 3: "Upgrade to Dedicated" + pricing CTA + 1-click "what's blocking you?"

Maya: Quickstart snippet to include in Cold 1:
```
curl -X POST 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' -d '{"model":"redwood-1-small","input":"Hello"}'
```

Camille: use HTML fallback for the snippet so it renders on mobile, and make the CTA button large.

Jordan: Measurement plan: opens, CTR->activate (first API call), activation conversion, pricing page views/contact. A/B test subjects on sends 1+2. target n=2k per arm for power.

Ethan: I'll add router rule in infra ticket #4567 and wire the Slack hook. will cc sales.

Priya: I'll map segments to Braze audience rules and add the routing pseudo-code in the sheet:
```
if (user.calls_last_48h == 0) send(campaign_cold)
else if (user.calls_last_48h <= 5) send(campaign_warm)
else send(campaign_hot)
```

Maya: Sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1EXAMPLE (columns: slice, subject_A, subject_B, preheader, body, link, gif, routing_rule).

Camille: Assets I'll prepare: 1 benchmark GIF, 2 screenshots, and a compressed hero image. uploading to marketing drive and will paste links in the sheet.

eng-bench-bot: Posting hourly CSV snapshots for flagged trial-hot users. sample export link added to the sheet; digest includes top 10 by tokens and top 10 by calls.

Maya: Next steps: Priya finish copy + variants by EOD Thu; Jordan set experiment flags & sample sizes; Ethan implement routing + Slack digest; Camille finalize creatives. Schedule a 30m sync Fri if any blockers.

Ethan: noted, will update infra ticket and ping #sales. thanks team :rocket:

Priya: Copy added to the sheet.

Maya: Great work. excited to iterate on this small series and measure lift.
